messages:
Maria L: FYI we're seeing a surge of SCIM provisioning 403s in ap-southeast-2 after the KMS rotation this morning. ~120 fails in the last 15m.
Maria L: Example error from scim-provisioner: 
```
ERROR scim: encrypted assertion unwrap failed: xmlsec: decryption failed (unsupported encryption algorithm: RSA-OAEP-256)
request_id=7a3b9e
service=svc-scim
```
Priya S: That was my rotate. I rotated alias/ri-key to new key version and set default_encryption_algorithm=RSA-OAEP-256 (we were on RSA-OAEP). I thought both sides supported it. Sorry. :grimacing:
Tom B: Which component does the actual XML decryption? idp-proxy or scim-provisioner?
Maria L: idp-proxy performs the EncryptedAssertion unwrap (it holds a KMS-wrapped symmetric key we unwrap and then decrypt assertion). The scim-provisioner just consumes the post-auth identity.
Tom B: Ok. So idp-proxy is failing to unwrap the encryptedKey because xmlsec/libxml doesn't accept OAEP-256 tag. Which xmlsec version are we running?
Leo R: We're on xmlsec 1.2.28 in the proxy container. It only supports RSA-OAEP (sha1) in our build. OAEP-256 is newer and not present unless built with openssl 1.1+ flags.
sec-bot: Incident created INC-4225: KMS key rotation -> SAML EncryptedAssertion decryption failures (ap-southeast-2).
Priya S: Immediate plan: revert KMS default_encryption_algorithm to RSA-OAEP and rekey requests so assertion producers go back to OAEP. Can do this now and push a canary to ap-southeast-2 only.
Maria L: Please also confirm whether any replayed assertions were stored by the proxy (we redact but could have metrics). We need to ensure no sensitive material leaked while decrypt failures happened.
Priya S: Reverted setting in KMS console for alias/ri-key -> default_encryption_algorithm=RSA-OAEP @ 10:07 UTC.
deploy-bot: roll/canary started: idp-proxy-config -> ap-southeast-2 -> 3 nodes
Tom B: After revert canary logs show successful unwrap on 2/3 nodes, one node still logging OAEP-256 failure for older messages (likely cached keymetadata). Clearing proxy key cache and forcing keymeta fetch should fix.
Maria L: I cleared keycache on that node and restarted proxy. Re-running a couple of failing provisioning jobs...
deploy-bot: provision job 45612 retried by Maria L
Maria L: jobs succeeded, error count back to baseline. :tada:
Leo R: Longer-term: we should either (A) upgrade xmlsec in idp-proxy to support OAEP-256 (non-trivial, needs OS/libssl changes + QA), or (B) make the proxy accept both OAEP and OAEP-256 by delegating wrapped-key unwrapping to KMS directly (KMS Decrypt API) and avoid xmlsec for that step. Option B is lower-risk and fast.
Priya S: Agreed, B seems safest. We can have KMS Decrypt return plaintext CEK and then proxy uses that to AES-decrypt assertion locally. I'll open a ticket for infra to allow proxy service principal kms:Decrypt on the key.
Tom B: We'll also add an audit alert: if >10% of SAML unwraps fail with algorithm mismatch in 5m, page oncall. And include metrics for encryption algorithm seen in assertion headers.
Leo R: I'll draft a short RFC for switching to KMS-level unwrap fallback and the upgrade plan for xmlsec (for full support). Add unit tests simulating OAEP-256 wrappedKey in the rolemapper test harness.
Maria L: Security check: did the rotation change key usage/permissions? Priya, confirm no broadening of access.
Priya S: No permission changes besides the algorithm flag. Key policy unchanged. I'll post KMS change ACL diff to the incident.
sec-bot: INC-4225 updated: mitigation applied (reverted algorithm), root cause identified, follow-ups assigned.
Maria L: Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) Priya open infra ticket for kms:Decrypt allowlist (Priya) 2) Leo create proxy fallback PR + tests (Leo) 3) Tom add alert + telemetry for algorithm mismatch (Tom) 4) Postmortem in INC-4225 with timeline and checklist (Maria).
Maria L: closing thread here, keeping the incident open until follow-ups complete.
